proofBoundary: Promotion requires the exact native traced GfxImage (nameHash,dataHash) pair, exact pair lookup in a supplied retail IPAK, CRC-validated extraction, byte-identical payload across every exact-pair match, and exact traced dimensions. Cross-root native tuple conflicts and IPAK byte/dimension conflicts are retained as unresolved evidence instead of being guessed through. dataHash-only fallback, filename/hash approximation, nearest-match behavior, and visual substitution are not admitted.
